findings.title: Mutable prediction state bypasses calibrated implementation binding
findings.reproduction: Create a one-dimensional unit covariance law observed=[0], mean=lambda t,e:array(t)+state['offset'], domain=True and full fixed Gaussian method null=[0]. Calibrate once. state offset=0 yields COMPATIBLE. Change only state['offset']=100: the same law/calibration returns REJECTED_CONJUNCTION and specification_id remains equal. Direct execution reproduced both outputs.
findings.repair: Bind supported mean/domain providers to immutable, checked numerical state; reject unsupported mutable callables at exact calibration, and test closure and callable-object state mutation. An object token alone is insufficient.
findings.acceptance_relevance: Blocks exact immutable law/method qualification in DESIGN section 2; no mutation of the actual DESI mean was observed.

findings.title: Gaussian-host quadrature loses support of a singular Student measurement convolution
findings.reproduction: ABSOLUTE one-host rows y=(.1,.123), measurement scale diag(1,0), host covariance [[.25]], common host design (1,1), mu=0, df=5, order=16. build_jwst_law(...,'STUDENT_T').loglik([0])=-inf. Exact density has H=y_B and epsilon=y_A-y_B, unit Jacobian, hence norm.logpdf(.123,scale=.5)+t.logpdf(.1-.123,df=5)=-1.2249863249101758. Numerical output reproduced.
findings.repair: Use the registered Gamma-precision convolution with covariance host_scatter+measurement_scale/lambda, retaining combined support and controlled integration; at minimum refuse support-enlarging singular convolutions rather than returning zero density. Test this exact two-row oracle.
findings.acceptance_relevance: Blocks normalized likelihood capability for an eligible declared singular law. No missing astrophysical input is involved; current JWST observed campaign remains scenario-only.

findings.title: Confidence inversion bypasses the known-covariance eligibility restriction
findings.reproduction: Construct unit covariance Gaussian law with approximation='EMPIRICAL_COVARIANCE', covariance_source='estimated'. invert_acceptance with alpha=.05 returns coverage_lower=0.95, construction FIXED_GAUSSIAN_ACCEPTANCE_INVERSE_IMAGE, and contains([1])=True. calibrate_method rejects the same approximation class. Direct reproduction succeeded.
findings.repair: Share the supported known-law qualification check with inversion and require separately justified acceptance for empirical/estimated covariance. Ensure combine_regions cannot consume an unqualified numerical coverage_lower as marginal coverage.
findings.acceptance_relevance: Blocks confidence/MES capability, independently of observed qiso result, because DESIGN section 4 restricts exact inversion to known Gaussian sampling covariance.

findings.title: External radiation-jet reference adapter rejects its own required output type
findings.reproduction: Backend.radiation_jet(event) returns RadiationJet(3.,2.7,'OUTWARD','normal','D'); matching ReferenceCase expected is that same typed jet. ExternalTransferProvider construction raises ValueError 'array requires real numeric values' in finite_array. Runtime _call conversely requires RadiationJet. No conforming typed backend can pass both paths.
findings.repair: Validate RadiationJet identity/convention/domain fields and each supplied numeric component through a typed comparator; use the same type in reference and runtime paths. Test a valid typed jet and a changed convention/component.
findings.acceptance_relevance: Eligible interface implementation defect, not unavailable physics. Actual external-reference data absence may still independently block empirical use.

findings.title: Positive support tolerance creates an unnormalized off-support Gaussian density
findings.reproduction: gaussian_loglik([0,.5],diag([1,0]),support_tol=1)=-0.9189385332046727, finite outside the declared singular support y2=0. Across the ambient tube |y2|<=1 its density integrates to 2, and it is not the original singular measure either.
findings.repair: Keep an exact support density distinct from a numerical acceptance enclosure; unresolved support residuals should be typed numerical uncertainty or handled by an explicitly normalized measurement-error law. Add an off-support density test with positive tolerance.
findings.acceptance_relevance: Generic normalization issue; conservatively enlarging an acceptance set alone need not reduce coverage. Actual qiso covariance is full rank and unaffected.

findings.title: Resume fingerprints omit physical kernels that determine cached node validation
findings.reproduction: Read implementation_sources: R7-03 includes driver, contracts, infer/r7 and obsstat/r7 but omits common/r7_radiation_jet.py. R7-15/16 include only driver+contracts and omit their bass/transfer providers. Resume reuses identical fingerprint/result/evidence. Therefore changes to these kernels do not invalidate their own scientific receipts. Static dependency witness; campaign was not mutated.
findings.repair: Add actual local physical kernel/test inputs to the relevant node dependency maps and a targeted resume test for radiation/provider edits, carrying unchanged nodes.
findings.acceptance_relevance: Blocks trustworthy reuse after the requested scientific repairs; operational provenance issue, not direct evidence that existing numerical values are wrong.

findings.title: Synthesis counts a copied observed scope as a second empirical scope
findings.reproduction: R7-19 contains the sole DESI compressed qiso scope. R7-21 copies scope_results from ancestors. synthesize_campaign concatenates both; actual R7-25 conclusion empirical_scope_count is 2 although only one unique full ScopeKey exists.
findings.repair: Deduplicate exact scoped results in synthesis, preserving producer provenance and reporting conflicts rather than double-counting reducer copies. Test one producer plus its copied comparison row.
findings.acceptance_relevance: Blocks accurate integrated-analysis accounting only; it does not mathematically double the likelihood or narrow the reported qiso interval.
